alice: Please add an explicit note about Dedicated vs Hosted throttles so readers don't conflate local rate limits with Dedicated burst policies.

jamal: Draft Python snippet for trimming: 

```python
# keep last N messages so token count fits model window
MAX_TOKENS = 8192
SAFETY_MARGIN = 256
if token_count(history) > MAX_TOKENS - SAFETY_MARGIN:
    # drop oldest turns until size fits
    while token_count(history) > MAX_TOKENS - SAFETY_MARGIN:
        history.pop(0)
```

sid: And short Node retry/fallback example: 

```js
// if we get 429, switch to lower-cap model and retry once
try {
  resp = await client.generate(req)
} catch (err) {
  if (err.status === 429) {
    req.model = 'rwd-medium'
    resp = await client.generate(req)
  } else throw err
}
```

maya: I'll also add an exponential-backoff snippet with jitter: `backoff = Math.min(2**attempts + rand(), 30)` and note max attempts = 5.
